operations.name: Saw Cut Gear Blank
operations.setup_note: Cut round bar into 30 mm blanks, leaving allowance for facing and part-off. Stock diameter remains subject to the missing finished tooth-tip diameter.

operations.name: CNC Turn – Main Bar Setup
operations.setup_note: Grip the saw-cut blank or bar in a chuck, face the exposed end, and maintain one spindle-axis setup for the blank ODs, datum bore, groove faces, and part-off. The finished bore establishes datum axis A, while same-setup turning controls OD runout and groove-face perpendicularity.

operations.name: CNC Turn – Second Face
operations.setup_note: Locate on datum bore A with an expanding mandrel and seat the finished first face against a stop. Face the parted side to the final 22.7 mm overall width and break the accessible edges without disturbing the datum bore.

operations.name: Hob External Gear Teeth
operations.setup_note: Mount the soft-machined blank on a precision expanding mandrel located by datum bore A and an axial face stop. Hob the two external geared sections in common angular phase across the central relief groove.

operations.name: Deburr and Clean
operations.setup_note: Remove hobbing and turning burrs from the tooth ends, groove, bore entrances, and faced edges, then clean the component. No heat treatment or coating is applied under the current drawing notes.

operations.name: Final Dimensional and Gear Inspection
operations.setup_note: Locate from datum bore A and an axial face for inspection. Verify overall width, bore profile, groove width and face perpendicularity, both geared-section runouts, and the specified gear geometry.

clarifications.question: What material specification applies to this component?
clarifications.suggested_default: Annealed or normalized machinable steel, treated as medium machinability.

clarifications.question: What is the finished tooth-tip outside diameter of the geared sections?
What dimensional profile defines the concave central through bore?
clarifications.suggested_default: Machine the profile by CNC contour boring from the supplied drawing geometry.

clarifications.question: What size tolerance applies to the central bore?
clarifications.suggested_default: DIN ISO 2768-m where applicable, with no honing or grinding requirement.

clarifications.question: What is the bottom diameter of the 2.7 mm annular groove?
Is the tooth count 43 on each geared section?
What module applies to the external gear teeth?
What pressure angle applies to the external gear teeth?
Are the external teeth straight spur teeth?
clarifications.suggested_default: Yes; use a zero-degree helix angle.

clarifications.question: What DIN or ISO gear quality class is required?
clarifications.suggested_default: Use a commercial hobbed quality with no gear shaving, grinding, or honing.

clarifications.question: Must the teeth on the left and right sections be in the same angular phase?
clarifications.suggested_default: Yes; hob both sections in one indexed setup.

clarifications.question: Does the drawing represent one monolithic component rather than an assembly of separate geared pieces?
clarifications.suggested_default: Treat the drawing as one monolithic machined component.

assumptions.text: The missing material is provisionally treated as annealed or normalized steel with medium machinability; no hardness value is assumed.

Round bar is selected because the part is rotational and no forging, casting, or directional grain-flow requirement is specified. The 30 mm cut length provides 7.3 mm total facing and part-off allowance; stock diameter is left undefined because the maximum OD is missing.
The component is routed as a single monolithic part despite the assembly-table references.
The concave through-bore profile is assumed accessible to CNC drilling, rough boring, and X-Z contour finish boring on the lathe.
F06 and F07 are treated as two sections of one 43-tooth external spur-gear system with matching tooth geometry and angular phase, allowing common hobbing from datum bore A.
Gear shaving is omitted because no gear quality or pre-heat-treatment shaving requirement is specified.

The gear-template heat-treatment, face-grinding, bore-honing, tooth-grinding, and tooth-honing steps are omitted because the drawing explicitly specifies no heat treatment and provides no hardened-gear requirement.
The gear-template pre-heat-treatment tooth deburr and final deburr/clean steps are merged into one post-hobbing bench operation because no heat treatment follows hobbing.
The turning-template threading step is omitted because no threaded feature exists in the feature graph.

A separate pilot-drilling step, peck drilling, reaming, tapping, countersinking, and counterboring from the hole-making sequence are omitted because the short through bore is contour-bored and no corresponding feature or tolerance requirement is identified.
The pre-loaded milling route is not applied because the feature graph contains no prismatic contour, pocket, slot, or off-axis hole requiring a milling setup.
